<!-- work-order:scenarios/proofs.md:V4b -->
## Outcome
the rest of V3: M8 and M9 stated in `LAWS.bend` over a `model.bend` that models the escalation chain (B13 to B17: hops, the sender never a hop, the bound) and the store's restart (B8), then `step` grows the same transitions and `inv_m8_escalation_terminates` and `inv_m9_restart_is_a_replay` pass; held by architect-b, who writes the model and laws (another architect approves, V3) and the failing `inv_` tests first, then a Builder makes them pass

## Acceptance
Scenarios: V4b
Specification: [scenarios/proofs.md](https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/proofs.md)

## Scope
`proofs/messages/model.bend`, `LAWS.bend` and `spec.bend` (architect only), `crates/messages/src/step.rs`, `crates/messages/src/lib.rs`, `crates/messages/src/store.rs`; the `inv_` test file is the architect's

## Preserve
`bend proofs/messages/PROOF.bend` prints `ALL PROOFS CHECK` with M8 and M9 stated (V5's runner); `inv_m8_` and `inv_m9_` pass

## Dependencies
after the V4 row and V5's spike merge; the model must exist before the tests can, because V4 says the model mirrors `step`

## Delivery
No implementation PR linked yet.

## Queue
Key: V4b
Priority: 100
Migration state: unspecified

Imported from the Work table. The issue-backed queue is being installed; this issue does not create a second Builder. Completion requires delivery evidence, not a matching test name.

deliveries.title: V4b-spec: write the V4b scenario in `scenarios/proofs.md`: M8 and M9 over a model with the escalation chain and the store's restart
deliveries.body:
## Outcome
`scenarios/proofs.md` on main has a `**V4b …**` scenario. Work Issue #376 cites `Scenarios: V4b`, but no such heading exists on main (`grep -c '^\*\*V4b' scenarios/proofs.md` prints 0). V3 names `m8_escalation_terminates` and `m9_restart_is_a_replay`, and V4 asks for an `inv_` test per law, but neither says what the model must add for them. #376 can't be built until this lands.

## Scope
`scenarios/proofs.md` only: add the V4b paragraph and update the header's id range. Mode: specify. No change to `proofs/`, `crates/` or `LAWS.bend`.

The paragraph states:
- the `model.bend` additions and their source rules: the hop chain (B13: the chain read once, Groups skipped, the sender `c` skipped if it appears), the per-hop bound as an explicit clock event (B14), landing as `held escalated` (B15), skipped hops and no loops (B16), an answer stopping the bubble (B17), and a restart event that drops `pending` and replays the stored records (B8, D6). Each one names the `step.rs` `Event` it mirrors, and the V4 transition-name check covers the new names.
- the exact claims of the two laws: M8 means every question reaches an answer, a drop or `held escalated` within hops + 1 bounds, never revisits a hop, and the sender is never a hop. M9 means the World after `restart` equals the replay of the stored records, and the next id continues the sequence.
- the replay bounds for `inv_m8_` and `inv_m9_` (V4 says at most 6 events and 3 Messages; if a chain needs more, the scenario names the bound and gives the reason).
- one mutant per new law in `proofs/messages/mutants/` that makes `bend` print `SOME PROOFS FAIL` naming that law (V3).
- who changes `LAWS.bend`: an author's PR whose independent review run approves the law text, per rule 4 and the Architect sweep (#371). A Builder never weakens a law.
- the dependencies: V5 (#375), and B1-B18 (#372) for the Rust escalation and restart behaviour that `step` must expose.

## Acceptance
Scenarios: V3, V4
Specification: [scenarios/proofs.md](https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/proofs.md)
Observer: on main, `grep -n '^\*\*V4b ' scenarios/proofs.md` prints one heading. Its paragraph names the model events for B8 and B13 to B17, the M8 and M9 claims, the `inv_m8_`/`inv_m9_` replay bounds, the mutants and the dependencies above. The specification PR's review run approves it.

## Preserve
V1 to V7 text stays unchanged apart from the header's id range. No law in V3 is weakened. `scenarios/messages.md` B8 and B13 to B17 stay the source of truth: V4b restates them and adds no new rule.

## Queue
Key: V4b-spec
Priority: 100
Mode: specify
Provider: any
